description: This file implements a TurnTraceObserver class for OpenTelemetry tracing within the Pipecat project. It manages conversation and turn spans, integrating with turn tracking events to create hierarchical trace spans for conversation flows.

classes.name: TurnTraceObserver
classes.description: An observer that creates and manages OpenTelemetry trace spans for each conversation turn, integrating with turn tracking events to provide hierarchical tracing of conversation flows.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TurnTraceObserver with turn tracker, optional conversation ID, and additional span attributes.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame push event; in this implementation, it does not modify frames.

methods.name: start_conversation_tracing
methods.description: Starts a new conversation span, generating a conversation ID if not provided, and sets relevant span attributes.

methods.name: end_conversation_tracing
methods.description: Ends the current conversation span and any active turn span, clearing context providers.

methods.name: _handle_turn_started
methods.description: Handles turn start event by creating a new turn span, setting attributes, and updating context.

methods.name: _handle_turn_ended
methods.description: Handles turn end event by ending the current turn span and updating context.

methods.name: get_current_turn_context
methods.description: Returns the span context of the current turn, if available.

methods.name: get_turn_context
methods.description: Returns the span context for a specific turn number.
